data.long_meaning: The name Sashank is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sas' which means 'God' and 'Shank' which means 'Mountain'. The name Sashank signifies the God of Light and represents the wisdom of the mountains. It is also believed to symbolize the Sun God. The name Sashank carries the meaning “God of Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sashank usually hope their child will grow to embody god of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name also honors the Sun God, who is the ultimate source of light and energy. In Hindu mythology, gods and goddesses are often associated with various natural elements, and the name Sashank embodies this relationship.
